ambiguity.detail: Gerald and Clarissa mock them from above, but their exact familial or social tie is unclear.
Reference to Alexander abandoning everyone else lacks context for a cold viewer.

verdict.hook_line: No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A devoted woman crawls through a dangerous, thorny briar patch to save her bound husband while cruel onlookers watch.
verdict.why_it_works: The flash-forward hook grabs attention immediately, followed by high-stakes physical agony and a desperate cliffhanger.
